falseSynonyms.zh: instant 更強調「幾乎零延遲」；immediate 也可表示「最近的、直接的」等其他意思。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The drug had an immediate effect. The app gives instant access.

falseSynonyms.zh: prompt 強調迅速而不拖延，尤其是回覆或行動。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We need immediate action. Thank you for your prompt reply.

falseSynonyms.zh: direct 強調沒有中介，不一定表示速度快。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She needs immediate help. She has direct contact with the manager.

falseSynonyms.zh: urgent 表示需要優先處理；immediate 表示時間上立刻。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Immediate treatment began. The case requires urgent attention.

falseSynonyms.zh: imminent 表示「即將發生」，尚未發生。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The patient needs immediate care. A storm is imminent.

falseSynonyms.zh: rapid 強調快的速度或變化，不一定是零延遲。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON There was an immediate reaction. There was rapid growth.

falseSynonyms.zh: eventually 表示最後、終於，與 immediate 的時間方向相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON He replied immediately. He eventually replied.

falseSynonyms.zh: immediate 是形容詞；immediately 是副詞。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON We need an immediate response. Please respond immediately.
